description:
OID_SUBJECT_ALT_NAME at pkix-identity/src/lib.rs:111 is a top-of-file const. OID_SMTP_UTF8_MAILBOX at line 498 is defined adjacent to its single use site.

Suggested rewrite: move OID_SMTP_UTF8_MAILBOX next to OID_SUBJECT_ALT_NAME under a single 'OIDs' comment block. Both are RFC-defined constants reachable from multiple code paths (the SmtpUTF8 constant is used by san_entry_matches_mailbox via the OtherName.type_id match guard); grouping them is the conventional shape for x509-cert consumers.
title: OID_SMTP_UTF8_MAILBOX defined mid-file rather than alongside OID_SUBJECT_ALT_NAME
